entry_points.text: Measure, attestation, send and receive share zero-length size query versus bounded buffers; receive validates locations, pins one writable page, maintains caches, issues firmware op with encryption mask, then unpins and frees.
Debug crypt slices by remainder and page offsets, pins and flushes both pages, uses direct op when aligned else temp-buffer op, unpinning each slice.
Move validates fd and ops, locks pair, rejects type mismatch, protected dest or bad source, reconciles cgroups, locks all vCPUs, validates, allocates, moves, marks source dead and unwinds.

SNP populate needs SNP guest with context, enforces page-sized length, zero flags and valid role with aligned source except zero role, checks private backing under slots lock, delegates per-page and writes resume cursors.
Ioctl rejects when disabled, treats null as success, copies descriptor, holds VM lock, blocks mirror-disallowed and legacy-for-SNP commands, dispatches by ID and reports copy-back fault.
Register needs encrypted non-mirror guest, pins read-only, flushes and appends under VM lock; unregister matches exact address/size, writebacks, unpins, unlinks and frees.
Pre-run rejects invalid protected areas, records host CPUs for selective flush, installs guest ID and requests flush on control/CPU change with fast-path retention.

exports.text: Bulk helpers expose whole-VM lock, unlock and creation query plus KVM file test, idempotent host unmap and generic populate walker.
SEV helpers expose per-vCPU LBR enable, SEV init with SNP/ES dispatch, GHCB teardown and protected vCPU teardown with save handling.
Platform exposes move-from-fd, mirror copy, SEV attribute query, per-CPU table init, global teardown and reclaim maintenance.

hazards.text: Flushes, isolated staging, busy rejection, slow paths and span checks contain stale plaintext, races and wrap faults; SNP start validates VM, copy, flags, policy and TSC with teardown; post-populate privatizes with reclaim and diagnostic writeback; bad flush and scratch get fallback or errors.

Population may partially complete with resume cursors, firmware status with IO failure, fault, invalid or interrupt retaining progress; destroy may leak ID, warns on surviving mirrors and unpins leftovers late; register must flush before unlock. External helpers are opaque pass-1 dependencies.

invariants.text: Enhanced-only save update runs once per vCPU under bulk lock, rejects debugged vCPUs, validates and flushes, captures ISA plus extended state with split legacy placement, then protects and enables LBR.

Lifecycle paths verify secure context and forward handle with policy/state report; SNP finish needs context and zero flags; certs need zero vCPUs; SNP predicate is build-dependent; alloc precedes ASID bind.

Debug staging normalizes to firmware granularity with isolated page and offset merge; secret needs contiguous flushed range; updates pin one page and reject empty/cross-page spans; mirrors allow only VMSA, status and debug crypt.
Source stays active during writeback so reclaim still sees SEV; ES sources need equal online vCPUs all already protected, non-ES has no extra checks.

SEV init sets enable and drops undecryptable traps; ES installs VMSA or invalid marker, advertises features, drops unemulable traps and refreshes GHCB; GHCB helpers write fields; pending init is per-VM flag.

Populate needs private slot, private-marked frame and non-private RMP entry; walk aborts on signal, pins per writeback flag and stops on first error; worker holds invalidation lock and marks uptodate only on success.

Region lookup needs exact address and size; ES needs caching, CPU features, LBR and low IDs with SNP/ES partition; caps mirror enables; SNP probe queries status page; startup filters types and builds VMSA mask.

GHCB exchanges fixed regs with validity checks; exits need descriptors plus per-category fields; responses store category/detail; map allows success plus two recoverables when enabled; diag gated; split aligns huge and retries busy.

locks.text: Bulk needs VM lock, fails busy during creation, takes vCPUs in order with unwind; pair rejects same VM, claims markers, takes dest then source; mirror surgery uses global mutex with both VM and all vCPU locks.

VMSA reload asserts per-vCPU mutex, publishes invalidations ordered, resolves private page under read lock with deferred reload on change; SNP decommission unbinds under global write lock and frees page.
Population holds slots lock across checks and walk; single-page worker adds file invalidation lock during resolve, validation and callback.
Ioctl and region ops hold VM lock; mirror copy holds both VM locks plus global mirror lock for link; VMSA update holds all vCPU locks across firmware transitions.
Global teardown omits ID bitmap lock as no guests survive; reclaim checks may run outside VM lock as membership is fixed before vCPUs exist.

state_machines.text: Controls gate by flavor with enhanced-only and general secure checks; debug direction selects op; migration splits start/data/finish/cancel with inbound validating peer/session before creating context.

Migration moves state, ASID, handle, pins, flags, regions and mirrors; init maps types to flags; destroy detaches mirrors, drains regions, decommissions; setup checks paging, caps, driver, IDs, cgroups, gating and mask.

SNP goes absent/allocated/started/bound with decommission on failure; finish measures VMSAs then optional identity/auth; VMSA update locks all vCPUs and protects; secondary creation parks halted and marks runnable even on reload failure.
Scratch needs nonempty length, present non-wrapping address, separates embedded from external use, contains embedded, enforces version/size ceilings with staging, else malformed input.

MSR page-state allows only private/shared with user handling and validates completion; batched scans from resume index, rejects misaligned entries, degrades huge splits, merges contiguous ops and separates generic from invalid failures.

structs.text: Firmware pairs kernel handle/address/length with userspace envelope echoing lengths; ioctl carries ID, pointer, error, fd; populate carries start, length, role, flags, source; finish carries flags, identity/auth and host-data.
Region holds pinned pages, count, address, size and link; VM state holds active/ES/need-init flags, ID, handle, fd, owner, cert enable, context and lists; populate bundle holds type, fd and error.
Page-state buffer is packed header plus flexible entries; host unmap treats empty as success, tears down views, propagates dirty, drops pin and nulls handles.

ABI covers legacy, migration and SNP commands with SNP rejecting pre-SNP IDs; types are default, soft, encrypted, ES, SNP; SEV group exposes VMSA, policy, cert-need; populate roles are normal, zero, unmeasured, secrets, CPUID.
Invalid marker denotes absent VMSA, communication and pending state; external scratch ceiling is sixteen pages; blobs bounded, save update is one page, debug granularity sixteen bytes.
